claim_boundary: same-owner phase threat modelling only; not exhaustive security or certification
data_flows: committed source Git blobs -> x1 provenance and novelty audit
synthetic constants -> x2 contracts and rejecting fixtures after x1 gate
owner Git blobs -> exact manifests and same-owner validation
terminal route candidate -> existing exact-title task only after all gates
out_of_scope: real astronomy, interferometry, imaging, metrology, calibration, worker study, observatory use, or device operation
production identity, empirical GMUT, governed THOS trial, legal, cultural, or Māori-authority review
scope: owner-local v666-v2 software, documents, Git history, validation receipts, and terminal route candidate

threats.asset: immutable Neris source and sibling lanes
threats.mitigation: exact-head additive branch, owner-only paths, no merge/reset/force-push, four-way gates
threats.residual_risk: operator command error remains possible and must be retained
threats.threat: accidental mutation, reset, merge, or ref reuse

threats.mitigation: path allowlist, x1 lifecycle test, staged review, immutable x1 manifest
threats.residual_risk: misclassified prose; manual review remains required
threats.threat: implementation or outcome leakage into the x1 freeze

threats.mitigation: 4,190-row exact and token-Jaccard audit plus domain and falsifier review
threats.residual_risk: automated similarity is not proof; bounded human review remains same-owner
threats.threat: duplicate, paraphrased, or schema-relabelled inherited proposals

threats.mitigation: synthetic fixtures, five-class scans, repository-relative paths, no task/thread IDs
threats.residual_risk: pattern scans are incomplete and never privacy certification
threats.threat: raw task identifiers, private paths, credentials, transcripts, or callable details in artifacts

threats.asset: radio-astronomy, interferometry, metrology, equipment, worker, site, sky, and affected-party authority boundaries
threats.mitigation: zero real people, arrays, antennas, observatories, sites, coordinates, sky targets, visibilities, images, instruments, measurements, calibrations, devices, or actions and an exact-gated authority docket
threats.residual_risk: terminology may still be incomplete or culturally inappropriate; authority remains external
threats.threat: software structure presented as astronomical, interferometric, imaging, metrological, instrumentation, safety, siting, or affected-party competence or acceptance

threats.asset: Māori language, concepts, data governance, and authority
threats.mitigation: exact gate, zero Māori wording authored, source-profile authority nonconversion
threats.threat: citation or synthetic labels converted into interpretation or authorization

threats.mitigation: typed placeholders, zero observations, dimensional abstention, explicit refusal
threats.threat: GMUT surrogate promoted to empirical likelihood, force, prediction, proof, or canon

threats.mitigation: represented-only dispositions and explicit missing-evidence ledgers
threats.residual_risk: no governed participants, independent review, real keys, or trust governance
threats.threat: proxy protocol or zero-key envelope presented as effectiveness or production identity evidence

threats.mitigation: exclusive external receipt, one-shot guard, zero credit for incomplete attempts
threats.residual_risk: same-owner validation is not independent reproduction
threats.threat: replaying a successful aggregate or laundering a failed attempt

threats.mitigation: PREPARED_NOT_SENT until final gate; fresh live roster/auth reread; exact-title single send
threats.residual_risk: opaque acknowledgement must remain unresolved without resend
threats.threat: premature, duplicate, ambiguous, or standby delivery

trust_zones: unexecuted external, professional, cultural, identity, and device domains
